teacher_info.introduction: I have been teaching English for more than 10yrs now. I have taught in schools, online and one on one tutoring. I have taken online courses on how to teach and have found certain methods that I feel work well.I have taught students anywhere from 3 years old to 60+years old. I started out teaching children and have now increased my experience to adults. I also have experience teaching business English to adults and helping recently graduated students through the interview process in English. My business background is in accounting/payroll and IT support. I am fluent in Spanish and having learned it myself have a very good understanding of the grammar and pronunciation. I believe that the most important in learning a new language is for you to speak as much as possible and lose your fear of making mistakes. I know how difficult it can be to learn a new language so I hope that through my experience I can help you. In our classes together we will learn grammar but focus mainly on speaking and accent. When we speak we speak in the past tense a lot so that is a place I like to begin usually. I recommend taking at least one class a week but more if possible. Learning a language should be fun and exciting so be prepared to laugh and enjoy my class! I look forward to meeting you!

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have been teaching English for over 10 years now.  I have taught students from age 3- 65 years old.  I believe that anyone no matter how young or old can learn a language if they find the correct method and teacher for them.  I like to provide a relaxed teaching environment.  If we are relaxed and having fun learning, retaining information will come.  I love to laugh so be prepared to have a good time in my class!
teacher_info.teaching_style: For new English learners I feel that starting with the past tense is helpful.  We are constantly talking about what happened in the past.  Using pictures and physical response also helps to solidify concepts in our mind.  It is important to engage all the senses when learning and I believe this includes sense of humor!  For intermediate to advanced speakers I like to select relevant topics from the news media and/or of interest to the student. I also help to prepare students for job interviews, teach about American culture, etiquette and American humor.   No matter what level you are the most important is that you speak, speak, speak!
